Parcel Management — CI/CD Pipeline

3 zones · 6 workflow files · split backend & frontend CD · develop → staging → production

CI Gate

  • PR → develop triggers ci.yml
  • dotnet build → unit → integration
  • Branch protection requires CI pass
  • ~2 min per PR

CD Backend

  • Push to staging (backend/** / terraform/**)
  • Test → Docker build → ECR push
  • Terraform apply → smoke test
  • ~7 min per deploy

CD Frontend

  • Push to staging (frontend/**)
  • npm ci → build → S3 sync
  • CloudFront invalidation
  • ~1 min per deploy

Path Filtering

  • CSS change → only frontend pipeline
  • API change → only backend pipeline
  • Both change → both run in parallel
  • No wasted CI minutes
